exposure: caesarean section (CS) in the second stage of labor
Station of the presenting fetal part at first cesarean section (CS) (low or high)
station of the presenting fetal part (low or high)
cohort: 11,850 women in Sweden, delivered by CS in 2001-2007, with a second delivery in 2001-2009
finding: A primary CS at a low station was associated with a subsequent spontaneous PTB, but not medically indicated PTB, and this risk was not affected by surgical technique at index CS.
